nodes.label: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
nodes.author: Tingyun Li et al.
nodes.rationale: Introduces BCIT method for conditional experience transfer in autonomous post-training, addressing when past update evidence should authorize compute allocation.

nodes.label: Conditional Experience Transfer
nodes.author: Tingyun Li et al.
nodes.rationale: Problem of determining whether source-context evidence of an update justifies allocating training compute from a changed parent model in autonomous post-training.

nodes.label: Boundary-Calibrated Intervention Transfer (BCIT)
nodes.author: Tingyun Li et al.
nodes.rationale: Method combining source evidence, applicability conditions, hard-conflict veto, and bounded validation to authorize full-training compute in autonomous post-training.

hyperedges.label: Autonomous LLM Post-Training with Experience Transfer
